subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellaretail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@stellarretail.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates

Hi Alex / Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and clear runway for an expansion tied to your new conversational routing project. Quick recap and next steps from my side:

- Ask: You want pricing that supports an initial renewal commitment plus a staged expansion over 12 months as you route more customer conversations (adding new routes/models).
- Current baseline: ~15M tokens/month (chat + reranking) today, expected to ramp to ~40-50M tokens/month by Q4 if pilot metrics hold.
- Primary constraints: goal is to keep unit economics at or below $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens) for budget planning; leadership wants to see blended rate options if we mix higher-cost models (bigger context / fine-tuned) with smaller routes.

Immediate next steps I promised on the call:
1) Send a preliminary pricing matrix showing step-up thresholds and a blended-rate example for mixed-model usage.
2) Outline recommended threshold bands (e.g., 0-10M, 10-30M, 30-75M) and illustrative $/1M tokens at each band.
3) Clarify how adding new routes/models affects blended rates and whether we can stage those as add-on SKUs.

I'm attaching a compact matrix I've used for similar retailers — it's a starting point we can iterate on. Can you confirm the expected volume ramp (low/expected/high) and any firm budget ceiling for the first 12 months? Once I have that I'll run the blended scenarios and loop in our AE (Vivek) and pricing lead (Rishi) to finalize.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachment stub: 20270305-stellar-pricing-matrix.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellaretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@stellarretail.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below:

- Volume ramp: low = 18M/mo, expected = 35M/mo, high = 55M/mo over 6-12 months.
- Budget range: we're aiming for $35K–$55K/month for inference across all routes initially (this is flexible if the blended unit economics make sense).
- Routes & models: Pilot will use two models (chat-small for standard routing, chat-large for higher-quality responses on top-tier customers). If we add another fine-tuned model for returns/ops, expect ~10-15% of traffic on that route.

Can you show a blended example where 70% is chat-small, 25% chat-large, 5% fine-tuned? Also curious how we'd structure step-ups (monthly vs. committed tiers) and whether there's a separate per-route surcharge.

We're aiming to get a sense of the renewal ask this week so procurement can start internal approvals.

—Alex
Head of AI Product, Stellar Retail
alex.turner@stellaretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellaretail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@stellarretail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates

Alex — thanks, that's exactly the mix I needed. Attached is a preliminary proposal:

- Sheet 1: Step-up bands (0-10M, 10-30M, 30-75M) with list prices by model class.
- Sheet 2: Blended example (70% chat-small, 25% chat-large, 5% fine-tuned) at the three volume points you provided.
- Sheet 3: Add-on route pricing considerations and notes on how we treat fine-tuned models for blended calculations.

High-level takeaways from the attached:
- Target blended $/1M tokens you mentioned (~$900–$1.2K) is achievable at the expected volume band (35M) with a modest volume discount and a 10-15% blended uplift for fine-tuned usage.
- Step-up structure: we recommend committed-tier pricing by quarter with a lookback true-up at each renewal to apply any overage credits — this preserves unit economics while giving you runway to scale.
- Adding new routes/models: treat as route add-ons with a nominal configuration surcharge for fine-tuned SKUs; as volumes migrate into the new route we recalculate the blended rate at the next quarter boundary.

I've attached the proposal as an xlsx and included the compact PDF matrix for quick reference. Please review and let me know if you want a 30-min pricing walkthrough this week. I'll also pull in Vivek and Rishi to confirm final margin/discounts before we share an official renewal amendment.

Cheers,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

[Attachment stub: 20270420-stellar-pricing-proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment stub: 20270305-stellar-pricing-matrix.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal & Expansion pricing — review and approvals

Looping you both for quick alignment on margins and blended calculations before Marissa sends the external proposal.

Key internal notes:
- The blended examples look market-competitive at 35M/month. We should hold target gross margin at ~50% after discounts.
- For fine-tuned routes, propose a +20% multiplier vs chat-large to account for additional infra + support. If customer keeps fine-tuned % below ~15% blended, overall blended stays within target.
- Confirming step-up bands as Marissa suggested (use 10/30/75 breakpoints).

Marissa — can you confirm whether Stellar wants quarterly committed tiers (recommended) or monthly? That affects contract language and the true-up cadence.

Thanks —Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellaretail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal & next steps — Stellar Retail renewal + expansion

Alex / Jordan — following internal alignment, attached is the updated proposal and a short summary of the changes we discussed. Highlights:

- Blended example updated to reflect the 70/25/5 split and the +20% fine-tuned multiplier for that route.
- Final recommended blended $/1M tokens: $1,050 at 35M/mo expected volume (this includes the fine-tuned uplift and a 12% volume discount off list).
- Step-up structure: quarterly committed tiers (10M, 30M, 75M). We will do a quarterly lookback and true-up for any overage/under-usage.
- Add-on routing: new routes treated as add-on SKUs; pricing will be re-blended at the next quarterly boundary (no surprise invoice in the interim).

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, we can convert to a renewal amendment + expansion schedule; I'll prepare a clean copy for signature and include the quarter-by-quarter committed volumes.
2) I can set up a 30-min handoff with our procurement/finance specialist to walk the amendment and the true-up mechanics.
3) If you're ready, I'll send a DocuSign for the amendment (link below) and schedule the kick-off for the expansion pilot.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tx/ABC123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Thanks again — appreciate the collaborative session.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
